load_video_from_path: use VideoPathHandler to load a video from a file path or directory with optional audio decoding
load_encoded_video: use VideoPathHandler to load an EncodedVideo from a single video file using pyav decoder
load_frame_video: use VideoPathHandler to load a FrameVideo from a directory of frames at a specified FPS
get_video_clip: use the Video abstract class get_clip method to retrieve frames between start and end times in seconds
review_video_abc: review the Video abstract base class interface for duration property and get_clip method
